---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.30in, bottom: 0.46in, x: 0.38in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.6pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [#link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] - share and adapt with attribution to Andrew Andrade: #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade")[#text(fill: navy)[https://github.com/mrandrewandrade]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"), size: 9pt, fill: charcoal, hyphenate: false)
#set par(leading: 0.5em, justify: false)

#let blank-field(label) = [
  #text(weight: "bold")[#label:]
  #h(5pt)
  #line(length: 1.7in, stroke: 0.55pt + slate)
]

#let page-header(section) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    align: horizon,
    [
      #text(size: 21pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Listening - Quick Marking]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: slate)[#section]
    ],
    [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]]
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
  #v(4pt)
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 14pt,
    [#blank-field("Class")],
    [#blank-field("Date")],
    [#blank-field("Teacher")],
  )
  #v(4pt)
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    fill: sail,
    stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
    inset: (left: 9pt, right: 9pt, top: 4pt, bottom: 4pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.8pt)[#text(weight: "bold")[Scoring:] 4+ = 2 marks · L4 = 1.5 marks · L3 = 1 mark · L2 = 0.5 marks · L1 = 0 marks. #text(weight: "bold")[AP] Attention & Presence · #text(weight: "bold")[N] Audience Notes · #text(weight: "bold")[D] Discussion & Connections · #text(weight: "bold")[C] Completion & Consistency · #text(weight: "bold")[IR] Integrity & Reflection. Knowingly inaccurate attention self-ratings may result in 0/2 for IR. #text(weight: "bold")[Learning Skills:] R, O, IW, C, I, SR.]
  ]
  #v(5pt)
]

#let table-header = table.header(
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Student]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[AP]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[N]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[D]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[C]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[IR]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[/10]]],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning Skills - R O IW C I SR]],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Observation notes]],
)

#let mark-table(rows, pad) = table(
  columns: (1.38in, 0.46in, 0.46in, 0.46in, 0.46in, 0.48in, 0.52in, 1.75in, 4.05in),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: pad),
  stroke: 0.6pt + mist,
  align: left + top,
  table-header,
  ..range(0, rows).map(_ => ([], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [])).flatten()
)

#page-header([Students 1-9])
#mark-table(9, 13pt)

#pagebreak()
#page-header([Students 10-18])
#mark-table(9, 13pt)

#pagebreak()
#page-header([Students 19-26])
#mark-table(8, 14.5pt)

#pagebreak()
#page-header([Students 27-34])
#mark-table(8, 14.5pt)
```
